name: Routine: Issue Triage
description: A Claude Code routine that reads new issues each morning, labels them by area and severity, and flags anything that looks like a regression.
commandTemplate: Review issues opened in {{repo}} since your last run. For each one: summarize it in a sentence, label it by area and severity, and say whether it looks like a regression of recent work. Post the triage as a comment on each issue. Do not change code.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.help: The owner/name of the repo to triage. Attach the same repository to the routine so it has a checkout.
